quest.title: "Hey, This Isn't Pumpkin Soup..."
quest.description: Verenata seems to be troubled by something. Go help her out.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x300, Primogem x40, Mora x20000, Hero's Wit x3, Mystic Enhancement Ore x3, Strange Part x1

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll help you. Let's go.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Just don't go drinking yourself into danger!

dialogues.speaker: Verenata
dialogues.text: Thank you! Let's try the first type, then!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Don't drink too much of it, {NICKNAME}! Just spit it out if something feels off, okay?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Don't worry, Paimon, I'll be fine.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmph. Paimon's just worried, you know...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm ready. Pass me the potion.

dialogues.speaker: Verenata
dialogues.text: This one's called the Super-Duper Potion, and it'll make you super strong! Well... in theory, at least.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You take the potion from Verenata and drink it in one go.\nIt has a pungent odor that's hard to bear, but it tastes sweet and sticky, and isn't hard to swallow.\nOtherwise, however, your body has no reaction to it.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: At her direction, you then wait until some Breacher Primuses become active.

dialogues.speaker: Verenata
dialogues.text: U—Um, so, did you defeat those creatures so easily because of the Super-Duper Potion?

choices.text: Exactly! You could even say it gave me Super-Duper Powers!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What kind of awful advertising slogan is that...

response.speaker: Verenata
response.text: Ah, thank you, thank you! So it was due to the potion's effects, then. I guess that's a Master Potioneer's recipe for you!

response.speaker: Verenata
response.text: Alright then. Let's bring the Super-Duper Potion testing to a close first. Next, let's test this Coasty-Toasty Potion!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Did you, uh, come up with these names yourself?

response.speaker: Verenata
response.text: No, I'm no good at making up names, so I just let others help me come up with much better ones...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, don't say that... Really, and for something like potions, the name should let you know what it does right away anyway, right?

response.speaker: Verenata
response.text: Hmm. I've never heard that before... But you're right! That's what a Master Potioneer should be like!

response.speaker: Verenata
response.text: #*cough* A—Anyway, are you ready to test this potion, {NICKNAME}?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Sure, let's start.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh boy, this one smells like a disaster too...

response.speaker: Verenata
response.text: Theoretically, this Coasty-Toasty Potion will spare you from the effects of the cold and keep you warm! Yeah. Probably.

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: You take the potion from Verenata. It smells like dusty, musty old leather...\nYou hesitate for a moment before drinking it all in one gulp. It's not a bad tasting drink, being spicy with hints of cinnamon and ginger... It reminds you of a crackling fireplace on a rainy day.\nOtherwise, however, your body has no reaction to it.

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Afterwards, you rest for a while at her instruction.

choices.text: I didn't feel much, but it was pretty sweet.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Eh? But it smelled terrible...

response.speaker: Verenata
response.text: Huh... Is that so? Did I get something wrong?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Don't be so down. At least it wasn't poisonous... We can take that as a win, right?

dialogues.speaker: Verenata
dialogues.text: #Are you alright, {NICKNAME}? Are you okay!?

dialogues.speaker: Verenata
dialogues.text: Sorry, sorry... I didn't know that the medicine would attract strange things like that...

choices.text: That happened because the potion made me all coasty and toasty, you know?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh, is that even how things work? Can you be coasty?

response.speaker: Verenata
response.text: Wow... Right! Aquatic animals do mistake warm things for the sun, which will attract them. That means... the potion worked! Thank you both, truly!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon really doesn't think that's how it works...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Aquatic animals...? Weren't those Pyro Slimes?

response.speaker: Verenata
response.text: I see... Hmm, hallucinogenic side effects... Alright, I've written it down. Well, at least it wasn't completely ineffective, but...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But its effects were terrible! It made huge crabs look like Pyro Slimes this time, but what if a more dangerous monster comes along next time!? What then?

response.speaker: Verenata
response.text: True... I've already bothered you so much already, but there's one final potion that needs testing... Are you still okay with that?

choices.text: As long as it's not poisonous, let's do it.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Though we'll only find out if it's poisonous when we test it...

response.speaker: Verenata
response.text: Yes! Thank you so much! Well, next up is... the Truesight Potion!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Eh? W—Wait just a minute!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: The first one was the Super-Duper Potion, the next was the Coasty-Toasty Potion, and this one's called...

response.speaker: Verenata
response.text: The Truesight Potion, which means it can "let people see the truth"... What's wrong with that?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Um... It's nothing... Paimon just thinks that this one's name is completely different compared to the others! It's like a 360 degree turn!

choices.text: Doesn't that mean it's no different?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh...? Uh... Paimon doesn't have that many fingers! You know what Paimon meant anyway!

response.speaker: Verenata
response.text: Hehe, that's because the Master Potioneer named the first two for me, and I named this one...

response.speaker: Verenata
response.text: I'm no good at names though, so it's definitely not as good as the names she came up with.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Really? Paimon thought it was the other way around... Either way, have some more confidence! In fact, that's a proper name for a potion...

response.speaker: Verenata
response.text: Mm, thanks. Anyway... This potion's different from the previous two, so it might be very dangerous... So please, come to my workshop.

response.speaker: Verenata
response.text: If we're in the sea, the environment should help moderate the potion's effects, and my workshop has tools to deal with the dangers, so...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wow, this one sounds like a real doozy...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Let's begin, then.

response.speaker: Verenata
response.text: Alright. Follow me!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Exactly! What would the point of all this be if we gave up halfway? That said... It's not like Paimon's not worried or anything, but...

choices.text: Don't worry, Pyro Slimes are weak.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Heh... Wait, no, it's just that you're too strong!

response.speaker: Verenata
response.text: Hmmm. Wait... Did you just say "Pyro Slimes"?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh! That's right... We actually only saw a bunch of huge crabs!

choices.text: Crabs? Yes, it's normal to see crabs near the coast.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But you really weren't normal just now!

choices.text: But the burning sensation was very real. I could even feel the heat waves coming from them...

response.speaker: Verenata
response.text: I see... Um, hallucinogenic effects... Alright, I've written it down. Well, at least it wasn't completely ineffective, but... *sigh*

response.speaker: Verenata
response.text: Regardless, it's great that you're alright! It's just that... Sorry, the potion didn't work again...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #It's fine! Anyway... Even though it smells terrible, it's at least half successful. You see, {NICKNAME} was totally fine even after drinking it!

dialogues.speaker: Verenata
dialogues.text: Here! This is my workshop, where I conduct my experiments!

dialogues.speaker: Verenata
dialogues.text: Okay, now for the next experiment, we'll be testing the Truesight Potion! Are you ready?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm ready.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oooh... Please be careful...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You take the potion from Verenata, and the rank odor of masses of dead Seagrass left to rot under the tropical sun assaults your nostrils, causing you to gag involuntarily...\nYou hesitate for a moment, and then drain it in a single gulp. The taste of the potion itself isn't nearly so awful, and in fact, it really lacks any kind of distinct taste...\nOtherwise, however, your body has no reaction to it.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Afterwards, you rest for a while at her instruction. Absolutely nothing changes during that time.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: But not long after...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It looks like nothing has changed... Phew, Paimon can stop worrying now...

dialogues.speaker: Verenata
dialogues.text: #Yes, but... {NICKNAME}, you look like you were stunned for a moment. What's wrong? Did you see something?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I saw... half of a semi-transparent boat?

dialogues.speaker: Verenata
dialogues.text: Really? Fascinating! But... um... can you provide a more detailed description?

choices.text: It was too far away, I couldn't see clearly.

response.speaker: Verenata
response.text: How very interesting, yes indeed! ...But it cannot serve as concrete proof of the potion's effects... You can't prove that you didn't mistake some reef or shipwreck for a "ghost ship," after all...

response.speaker: Verenata
response.text: So... *sigh* The results of this experiment are inconclusive.

response.speaker: Verenata
response.text: Thanks to you both, I've collected a great many awesome notes this time! I'll definitely be able to use them for the next batch of potions!

response.speaker: Verenata
response.text: Hmm... "Though I've heard something very familiar..." Yes, "But there's still so much to observe, to see if others can see the same phenomenon"...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh? Does that mean that you still need to find other people to help you test your potions?

response.speaker: Verenata
response.text: Yes, that's correct. Because... um... I must have two or more reliable witnesses who see the same thing in order to prove that the potion really can allow people to see the "truth," right?

response.speaker: Verenata
response.text: The "truth" will not be limited or constrained by the eyes and perspectives of the viewer, and won't be distorted by what is in their heart... It objectively exists there, and it just is.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmmm... like... like gods that live for thousands of years?

response.speaker: Verenata
response.text: No. Like the white sand, like the bones of seastars, like the waves that crash and pound... those are "truth."

response.speaker: Verenata
response.text: But the Master Potioneer has also said... that "truth" can also be created through dreams and memories. I don't quite get it, and it seems like a contradiction to me... but I'm trying my best to understand.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wow... The topic got so deep so quickly...

response.speaker: Verenata
response.text: Haha, then let's not talk about such things for now! Anyway, I'd like to thank you for your help! Please, take these!

response.speaker: Verenata
response.text: Hmm... Also, be sure to come back again next time I make a new potion!

choices.text: It looked like it had been cut in half by something huge...

response.speaker: Verenata
response.text: Ah! Sorry! I... must have drifted off for a second there. But... but I've already written it all down. Thank you very much!

dialogues.speaker: Verenata
dialogues.text: Hmm... A Tidalga slurry, the crushed innards of Lumitoile, and a little... Wait, how much is a "little" exactly?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, are you making some soup? ... Urgh, that smells really weird...!

dialogues.speaker: Verenata
dialogues.text: Hmm? It smells weird? That can't be. I followed the formula Carabosse gave me exactly, so it should smell normal...

choices.text: It smells like someone fermented a sea bass for three years in a vat of dead frogs...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Urp, did you have to say that? Now Paimon has that image in her head...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: A—Anyway, what are you doing? Do you, uh, need help?

response.speaker: Verenata
response.text: It's a potion! I'm formulating a potion... one that'll help lots of people.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So you're a potioneer, then?

response.speaker: Verenata
response.text: Not yet! I'm just an assistant to a Master Potioneer. Her name is Carabosse, and I, Verenata, still have much to learn from her.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe, well, an assistant to a great doctor must be a great assistant, right?

response.speaker: Verenata
response.text: Hehe... Ye— W—Wait, no! Not at all!

response.speaker: Verenata
response.text: I'm... There are so many things I still don't know. I'm just working as hard as I can to help her make potions.

response.speaker: Verenata
response.text: Also... U—Um, I've told you my name, but I don't know yours yet.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Paimon's Paimon, and {M#he's}{F#she's} {NICKNAME}.

response.speaker: Verenata
response.text: "Paimon." What a nice name. Reminds me of a noisy white jellyfish.

response.speaker: Verenata
response.text: #{NICKNAME}. That's a slightly strange name, and it gleams like gold, but it's very friendly. Pleased to meet you!

response.speaker: Verenata
response.text: And, well, you just asked if I need help, and I do... But I don't know if you'd be willing to help...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Ask away.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Exactly! If you need help, you should just say so!

response.speaker: Verenata
response.text: I'd like you to... try my new potions.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Eh?

response.speaker: Verenata
response.text: I know potions smell and taste bad... but they can help lots of people and cure many illnesses. They're very useful things.

response.speaker: Verenata
response.text: But we can't get sick, and we don't like drinking strange things. Over time, people stopped helping me taste my potions — and that's been a big problem for me.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh... You're the one who said this stuff is weird! It isn't dangerous, is it?

response.speaker: Verenata
response.text: It's fine. We don't get poisoned by them. Um... so you shouldn't either... Well, at least in theory, anyway.

response.speaker: Verenata
response.text: There are a total of three potions that need testing. One will help people fight better! The other will keep people feeling warm. And the last one, um...

response.speaker: Verenata
response.text: I'm not sure how to put this, but Carabosse says that it can help people understand the truth. That's what she said, anyway... I'm still not sure what it means...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That does sound dangerous...

response.speaker: Verenata
response.text: No, no, it's not dangerous... Anyway, would you like to help? If you would, I'll take you to the test site now!

choices.text: If you calm down a bit, you can smell the fragrance of Sweet Flowers...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey, that's not right either!

dialogues.speaker: Verenata
dialogues.text: You're back! Wanna help me test the potions?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm not quite ready yet.

dialogues.speaker: Verenata
dialogues.text: Don't worry, I will wait here.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Alright, let's get a-testing.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: I'll come too. I'll keep an eye on you!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I still need to consider.

dialogues.speaker: Verenata
dialogues.text: The potion's getting cold... But it's alright. I'll wait!

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: A while later, you arrive at the beach.
